hero.name: Immersive Episteme
hero.tagline: Learn one Indian hand-block-printing tradition from a visual course or by walking its working yards in 3D, from one cited stage template, and measure what each way teaches.
hero.label: Immersive Episteme: learn a hand-block-printing tradition from a visual course or a 3D walk through its yards, and measure what each way teaches

cards.label: What the platform does: two doors, one study engine, cited knowledge, telemetry and the research console

items.title: A visual course
items.body: One panel per stage: name, cited caption, the tools and materials, and the cloth before and after.

items.title: Walk the working yards
items.body: A real-time Three.js walk from station to station, with the same words painted where the work is done.

items.title: One engine, one protocol
items.body: Consent, a blind pre-test, allocation by stratified blocks, tests, a concept map and a delayed test.

items.title: Every claim cited
items.body: Concepts, claims and links carry quoted sources; learners see a stage only once a curator verifies it.

items.title: Measured alike
items.body: Both doors send the same events in batches, stored append-only, checked for gaps and timed per stage.

items.title: Dashboard and exports
items.body: The registered outcomes, live session figures, concept-map scoring and CSV exports with a data dictionary.

pipeline.label: How knowledge reaches a learner and comes back as data: curate, import, verify, snapshot, learn, measure

stats.label: At a glance: two doors from one template, six curated traditions, three in the study, one tradition per participant

tiles.label: A course and a walk, one template

timeline.label: The platform so far: the foundation on 14 October, both conditions on 15 October, the walk through the yards on 4 November, real studies on 7 November, one tradition per participant on 8 November, deployed on Supabase PostgreSQL 17 in Mumbai on 9 November

items.title: One tradition each
items.sub: Balanced by door, roles by task
